title: Dad & Son Get Into Physical Altercation and Chaos Erupts At The Airport
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On February 17th, 2024. Officers were called to the airport in regards to two males who seemed to be in a physical altercation. When officers approached the man, he was extremely tensed up and agitated, officers tried to calm him down to figure out what was happening however , due to his attitude, officers had to place him under arrest. The man continued to be irate throughout the entirety of the arrest. It turns out that his dad was having a PTSD episode and his son was trying to calm him down however it led to them pushing and shoving each other. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
